[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Arborio rice brands, including Acquerello, Riso Scotti, Carnaroli, Lundberg, Bob's Red Mill, and Anson Mills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided storage tips for Arborio rice, including using an airtight container, storing in a cool, dry place, keeping it away from strong-smelling foods, and using it within 6-12 months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested freezer storage for Arborio rice if not used within 6-12 months and advised labeling and dating the container.
